title: Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer: loop changes on the shared ring linker, with a named reason for each lift (identical output)

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Part of #3743. Builds on step 1 (#3750). Step 8 of the migration.

## What happens

Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer ride the loops of the region, with no offset (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs:341-378` `trace`, `chamfer.rs:108-135`). They have no Links field. `Motion::new` (`levels.rs:187-196`) gives them `Links::PLANAR`, so they lift at each loop change by `Retract`, with no reason. Their entry is a plunge with no choice (`slots.rs:349-362`).

A link at depth from one engraved loop to the next cuts the part. Thus the lift is correct, but it has no named reason.

## Fix approach

1. The loop changes use `ring_links`. The proof refuses a link at depth across the part, so the lift stays and gets a named reason ("the link would cut the part").
2. The entry uses `ring_entry`. Keep the plunge where the op asks for it (a V-bit or a chamfer bit is not a helix tool). Name the entry kind in the notes.

## Pins (equivalence)

- The CL moves of `crates/app/tests/engrave_law.rs`, `crates/app/tests/mill2d_b.rs` (engrave), `crates/motion/tests/chamfer_circular.rs` and `crates/app/tests/chamfer_modelled_edge.rs` are the same as on the head before this change.
- Each lift of these ops has a named reason in the notes.
- The verifier verdicts and the gouge checks do not change.

Effort `high`: three ops move to the shared linker, under the safety floor. Priority P2: a consolidation with identical output.

Done means: Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer link only through `ring_links`, each lift has a reason, and the pins are green.
